messages.content: Find songs similar to those on the album 'The New Classic' Additionally, I'd like to explore tracks released around six years ago. This year is 2023

function.name: Music_3_PlayMedia
function.description: Initiates playback of a specified music track on a designated device. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

track.description: The title of the track to be played.

artist.description: The name of the artist performing the track.

device.description: The name or location of the device where the music will be played.

album.description: The name of the album that the track is from, if applicable.

function.name: Music_3_LookupMusic
function.description: Finds songs that align with the user's musical preferences based on the artist, album, genre, and release year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

artist.description: The name of the artist performing the song. Use 'dontcare' to ignore this criterion.

album.description: The name of the album that the song is part of. Use 'dontcare' to ignore this criterion.

genre.description: The genre of the music. Use 'dontcare' to indicate no specific preference.

year.description: The year of the song's initial release. Format should be a four-digit number, e.g., '2001'. Use 'dontcare' to ignore this criterion.

message.reasoning:
User wants find songs similar to those on album 'The New Classic', plus tracks released about six years ago (so ~2017). They want suggestions.

We can use Music_3_LookupMusic function. Provide artist? We don't know artist; maybe we need to guess. But user didn't specify artist. Could ask clarifying question. However they said "similar to those on the album". So likely same artist. Let's assume it's an album called 'The New Classic'; could be by some known artist. Quick recall: There is an album titled "The New Classic" by J. Cole? Actually J. Cole has "The New Classic"? No that's not his. There's "New Classics" by something else. Might be "The New Classic" by KSI? Not sure. Maybe it's by "Khalid"? Wait Khalid had "American Teen". Hmm.

Better approach: Ask clarification: Which artist? Or provide general search ignoring artist but using album as filter. Since album param exists. We'll set album="The New Classic".

Also include year=2017 approximate. For "six years ago" relative to 2023 -> 2017. So year parameter choose "2017". That matches allowed values list includes up to 2019 only. Yes includes 2017. Good.

Genre unspecified so leave default dontcare.

Thus call function:

{
    "album": "The New Classic",
    "year":"2017"
}

But also might want to get similar songs across other artists. Without specifying artist may return many results. That's okay.

Let's do it.
